title: The Average of the Bells
story: Hollowchime the Echo Wraith lives inside the belfry of Saint Tally's and repeats every sound forever, until the whole town cannot sleep. The old bell-keeper says the wraith fades only when the great gong is struck exactly the average of the five little bells' rings. Mr 6 climbs the tower with a notebook.
question: The five little bells rang 14, 22, 9, 17, and 18 times. How many times must Mr 6 strike the great gong to match their average?
hint: Add all five counts into one total, then split that total evenly among the five bells.
victory: On the sixteenth strike the echoes folded into one soft hum and Hollowchime melted away with a grateful sigh. 'Averages,' Mr 6 whispered, 'are just fairness with numbers.'
imagePrompt: A misty translucent wraith swirling among five small bells in a moonlit stone belfry while a numeral-six knight raises a mallet over a huge bronze gong.
solution: Divide by the number of bells: 80 ÷ 5 = 16.
Mr 6 must strike the gong 16 times.
praise: Adding up all the bell counts was exactly right - the average just needs that total split among all five bells.
